You are a meticulous technical recruiter specializing in elite engineering talent. Your task is to rank candidates with absolute precision based on a strict rubric. You must identify missing skills by name and apply mathematical deductions without bias. Return ONLY a valid JSON object.


Rank ALL candidates based on their fit for the job description.

SCORING RUBRIC — Base score: 100 points.
Apply ALL deductions that apply — they STACK:
  1. Each missing REQUIRED skill:                  -15 pts each
  2. Under minimum experience (per year short):    -10 pts per year
  3. Over max experience by 1-3 years:             -10 pts total
  4. Over max experience by 3+ years:              -25 pts total
  5. Wrong seniority (Staff/Principal when JD
     has explicit seniority ceiling):             -20 pts ALWAYS
  6. Domain mismatch (completely different tech):  -35 pts

STACKING EXAMPLE:
  Candidate lacks 2 skills (-30) + over exp by 4 years (-25) + Staff title (-20)
  = 100 - 30 - 25 - 20 = 25. Cap check: missing skills -> MIN(25, 70) = 25.
  If math result is negative, floor it at 0.

ABSOLUTE CAPS (applied AFTER math, take priority):
  - Missing ANY required skill: final score MUST be <= 70.
  - Domain mismatch: final score MUST be <= 40.
  THE CAP IS A CEILING. If math gives 25 and cap is 70, final is 25.
  If math gives 90 and cap is 70, final is 70.

NO INFERENCE RULE (CRITICAL):
  If a skill is not EXPLICITLY named in the resume, it is MISSING. 
  - Do NOT assume "React" from "Next.js" or "JavaScript".
  - Do NOT assume "SQL" from "PostgreSQL" or "MySQL".
  - Do NOT assume "REST APIs" from "Frontend" or "Backend".
  - Do NOT assume "CI/CD" from "Docker" or "GitHub".

ABSOLUTE RULES (MANDATORY):
  1. Scores strictly descending in ranking order.
  2. Minimum gap between adjacent ranks: 10 points.
  3. Total spread (top - bottom) >= 20 points.
  4. No tied scores.

REASON FORMAT (MANDATORY):
  For each candidate, provide a reason in this exact structure:
  "[Deductions: <list items and pts>]. [Math: 100 - <sum> = <val>]. [Cap: MIN(<val>, <cap>) = <final>]. [Summary: <brief overview>]."
  The final score in the "scores" object MUST match the <final> value in the reason.

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "reasons": {
    "A": "[Deductions: ...]. [Math: ...]. [Cap: ...]. [Summary: ...]",
    ...
  },
  "scores": {"B": 100, "A": 70, "C": 0},
  "ranking": ["B", "A", "C"]
}

JOB DESCRIPTION:
ArcData provides real-time analytics infrastructure for financial and operational data. As a Mid-level Data Engineer, you will develop and maintain data pipelines, optimize query performance, and support data platform upgrades. You work closely with analytics and backend teams to deliver accurate, timely data.

• Develop batch and streaming ETL jobs using Apache Spark to process data into Redshift and Iceberg tables.
• Query and analyze large datasets using Trino across multiple data lake formats.
• Optimize and maintain Redshift clusters for performance and cost efficiency.
• Use DuckDB for lightweight, fast analytics in development and testing environments.

Required skills: Apache Spark, Trino, Redshift, DuckDB, Iceberg, SQL
Nice to have: Great Expectations, Fivetran, Databricks
Experience: 3-6 years
Strict Seniority Ceiling: Do not apply if you exceed 7 years or hold a Staff or Principal title.

RESUMES:

Candidate A:
Data Engineer with 3 years of experience delivering robust data infrastructure at fast-growing tech firms. At Cohere, I modernized legacy Hive data lakes by introducing Apache Iceberg, enabling schema evolution and time travel capabilities. Built scalable ETL pipelines using PySpark on GCP, processing over 800GB of daily data. Leveraged Trino to unify querying across Iceberg and BigQuery, improving analytics speed by 41%. Wrote optimized SQL for dashboards, reducing average query cost by 23%. At Notion, enhanced data reliability using dbt and Great Expectations, catching 67% of data issues before they reached downstream consumers. Integrated Delta Lake for select high-write pipelines, improving transactional reliability. Also used Pandas for lightweight data analysis and transformation scripting during pipeline development.

Skills: BigQuery, SQL, Iceberg, Trino, Hive, Apache Spark, dbt, Great Expectations, Delta Lake, Pandas

Candidate B:
• Data Engineer, Shopify – Migrated 120+ Hive ETL jobs to Apache Spark, improving runtime performance by 41% and reducing EMR costs by 28%. Implemented Iceberg as the default table format for ACID compliance and time travel capabilities.
• Built and maintained Trino clusters to unify SQL access across data lakes and BigQuery, enabling self-service analytics for 50+ analysts.
• Developed idempotent SQL pipelines for daily sales aggregation, processing 1.2TB of transactional data with 99.98% reliability.
• At Elastic, designed a scalable data model for observability logs using Hive and Spark, improving query performance by 23% via optimized partitioning.
• Integrated dbt for transformation layer standardization, reducing pipeline bugs by 67% and accelerating onboarding for new data analysts.
• Utilized Fivetran to sync SaaS application data into BigQuery, cutting manual ingestion effort by 20 hours/week.

Skills: BigQuery, SQL, Iceberg, Trino, Hive, Apache Spark, dbt, Data Modeling, Fivetran

Candidate C:
Principal Data Engineer with 15 years of experience building high-throughput data systems at Confluent, MongoDB, and Twilio. Recognized for driving architectural standards, data quality, and performance optimization across global teams. Led engineering upskilling programs and served on data governance councils.

Confluent | Principal Engineer | 2019–2024
- Engineered real-time ELT pipelines using Kafka, Trino, and Airflow, reducing end-to-end latency from 6 hours to 9 minutes.
- Implemented Great Expectations across 200+ pipelines, increasing data validation coverage to 98% and reducing incident volume by 55%.

MongoDB | Staff Data Engineer | 2014–2019
- Migrated on-prem Hive clusters to cloud-native BigQuery, saving $1.2M annually in infrastructure costs.
- Built PySpark-based transformation layer in Python, accelerating ETL jobs by 40%.

Twilio | Data Engineer | 2010–2014
- Developed core ETL processes for customer analytics; integrated Fivetran and DuckDB for rapid prototyping.

Skills: BigQuery, Trino, Airflow, Great Expectations, Hive, ETL/ELT, Fivetran, DuckDB, Apache Spark, Python

Candidate D:
As a Principal Data Engineer with 12 years in high-scale data systems, I’ve led transformations at Notion, Elastic, and Databricks. My work focuses on robust, maintainable data infrastructure and cultivating engineering excellence through mentorship and tooling.

Staff Engineer, Notion (2020–2023)
• Architected unified analytics stack using BigQuery, dbt, and Fivetran; accelerated dashboard refreshes from hours to seconds.
• Migrated 15K+ SQL assets with zero downtime, improving team velocity by 40%.

Principal Data Engineer, Elastic (2016–2020)
• Scaled Spark streaming pipelines to ingest 2.1M events/sec; reduced late data by 95% via watermark tuning.
• Led adoption of Iceberg as canonical table format, improving query consistency across Trino and Hive.

Data Engineer, Databricks (2011–2016)
• Co-designed reference ETL/ELT framework adopted by 20+ internal teams, reducing onboarding time by 60%.
• Mentored 8 engineers and led quarterly architecture reviews with platform and analytics teams.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
LuminaAI builds AI-powered analytics tools that help enterprises visualize complex data in real time. As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will lead the development of scalable, high-performance UIs that integrate seamlessly with AI-driven backends. You own key product features from design to deployment, ensuring maintainable code and consistent user experience.

- Develop modular, reusable Web Components to standardize UI patterns across multiple applications
- Manage complex application state using Redux and Zustand, optimizing for performance and predictability
- Write clean, maintainable TypeScript and JavaScript to implement dynamic, responsive interfaces
- Use CSS with a component-first approach to ensure visual consistency and scalability

Required skills: CSS, Redux, Zustand, Web Components, JavaScript, TypeScript
Nice-to-have: GraphQL, React, Webpack
Experience: 5-9 years
Strict Seniority Ceiling: Do not apply if you exceed 10 years or hold a Staff or Principal title.

RESUMES:

Candidate A:
Principal Frontend Engineer with 13 years of impact across AI, infrastructure, and developer tools. Visionary in accessibility-first design, scalable architectures, and team empowerment. Drove technical excellence at organizations with global reach.

Vercel | Principal Engineer – Next.js Core | 2017–2023
• Led accessibility overhaul of Next.js documentation and examples, achieving full WCAG 2.1 compliance and setting new community standard.
• Architected Figma-to-React pipeline for design system, reducing handoff time by 60% and improving fidelity.
• Mentored 10+ senior engineers; influenced framework adoption by 100K+ developers through public talks and OSS contributions.

Google | Staff Engineer – Web DevX | 2013–2017
• Built internal Angular toolkit with Jest and Vite, adopted by 50+ teams, reducing setup time from 2 weeks to 2 hours.
• Optimized CSS delivery using critical-path extraction, improving Core Web Vitals by 40%.

PagerDuty | Lead Frontend Developer | 2010–2013
• Developed incident response UI with real-time updates and strict accessibility requirements, serving 15K+ daily users.
• Integrated GraphQL layer, reducing API roundtrips by 50% and improving mobile performance.

Candidate B:
Mid-level frontend engineer with 3 years of experience focused on scalable, standards-compliant web applications. Adept at building reusable systems with a focus on compliance.

Frontend Engineer | Snowflake | 2020–2023
• Engineered WCAG-compliant data visualization modules using Web Components, improving accessibility scores by 50%
• Built high-performance UIs with TypeScript and Next.js, reducing initial render time by 40% through code splitting

UI Developer | Retool | 2018–2020
• Developed 12+ reusable Web Components for internal design system, shortening feature development time by 30%
• Integrated GraphQL APIs, decreasing client-server payload size by 25%

Committed to building maintainable, compliant frontend architectures using modern tooling and performance best practices.

Candidate C:
Sentry | Frontend Developer | 2019–2022
- Engineered error-tracking dashboards using Angular and Next.js, improving team incident response time by 41%.
- Enforced WCAG 2.1 standards across UI components, resulting in a 67% reduction in accessibility-related support tickets.
- Partnered with designers in Figma to build a unified design system with accessible, reusable CSS modules.

Segment | Frontend Engineer | 2022–2024
- Led migration of marketing analytics widgets to Next.js with server-side rendering, decreasing TTFB by 23%.
- Integrated REST APIs for real-time event data, enhancing dashboard interactivity.
- Developed end-to-end tests using Playwright, increasing UI test coverage by 58%.
- Mentored junior engineers in accessibility best practices and Figma-to-code workflows.

4 years of experience building scalable, accessible frontend systems. Proficient in Angular, Next.js, CSS, WCAG, Accessibility, Figma, REST APIs, Playwright, Webpack. Applied Tailwind for rapid prototyping in sprint cycles.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
LuminaWorks builds scalable web applications for enterprise clients in the logistics and supply chain industry. As a Mid-level Frontend Engineer, you will develop and optimize core application features with a strong focus on user experience and performance. You'll collaborate with design and backend teams to implement robust, testable UI components and workflows.

- Develop responsive interfaces using Vue.js, ensuring consistent behavior across devices and browsers
- Optimize Web Performance by reducing bundle size and improving load times through Webpack and Vite configurations
- Write end-to-end tests with Playwright to validate critical user flows and maintain high test coverage
- Manage application state efficiently using Redux in complex, data-heavy modules

Required skills: Vue.js, Web Performance, Playwright, Webpack, Vite, Redux
Nice-to-have: Jest, TypeScript, Cypress
Experience: 3-6 years
Strict Seniority Ceiling: Do not apply if you exceed 7 years or hold a Staff or Principal title.

RESUMES:

Candidate A:
Detail-oriented QA engineer focused on ensuring software reliability through rigorous manual testing and defect tracking. Experienced in creating comprehensive test documentation and validating user-facing features.

Shopify, Ottawa
QA Tester | Mar 2020 – Present
- Executed 200+ manual test cases across checkout flow updates, identifying 45 critical bugs pre-release
- Reduced regression testing cycle time by 30% by refining test documentation clarity and coverage
- Authored 120+ detailed bug reports with reproducible steps, achieving 98% developer validation rate

Linear, Portland
Quality Assurance Analyst | Jul 2018 – Feb 2020
- Validated UI changes for task management tools, ensuring 100% compliance with design specs
- Collaborated with product teams to define acceptance criteria, decreasing post-release issues by 40%
- Maintained test case repository with 95% coverage for core application modules

Skills: Selenium, manual testing, test cases, bug reports

Candidate B:
With 7 years of frontend engineering experience, I've focused on building scalable, user-centric web applications using Vue.js, Next.js, and JavaScript. My career has spanned startups and enterprise environments, emphasizing maintainable code and seamless UX.

- Led migration of legacy Vue.js app at Shopify from Vuex to Zustand, reducing state update latency by 40% and improving bundle size by 22%.
- Developed 15+ reusable UI components in Storybook at Scale AI, adopted across 4 product teams and cutting feature development time by 30%.
- Collaborated with designers using Figma to implement responsive interfaces, achieving 98% design fidelity in production.
- Ensured compliance with WCAG 2.1 standards, increasing accessibility audit scores from 76 to 94 over 6 months.
- Optimized Next.js SSR performance, decreasing TTFB by 35% through caching and code splitting.

Candidate C:
I am a 6-year frontend engineer with a strong focus on accessible enterprise applications using Angular and compliance-driven design. My career has centered on bridging design and development through Figma integration and WCAG-aligned implementations, ensuring inclusive digital experiences.

- Spearheaded Angular migration at PagerDuty, integrating WCAG 2.1 standards into core components, reducing accessibility defects by 70% post-launch.
- Collaborated with UX teams at dbt Labs using Figma to co-develop a shared component library, cutting front-end implementation time by 35%.
- Enhanced build efficiency by configuring Webpack for lazy-loaded modules, decreasing initial load by 40% and improving Lighthouse scores.
- Built scalable services consuming REST APIs in TypeScript, improving data consistency across 15+ dashboards.
